Title: General Availability: Oracle software on Azure

Body.Content: Oracle Database, Oracle WebLogic Server, and Java are now generally available with license-included virtual machine images, and you can find them in the Azure Virtual Machines image gallery. Whether you’re an Oracle administrator or a Java developer, you have full Oracle support. Learn more at Azure.com.
